expected.executiveSummary: The team conducted a final rehearsal for an upcoming webinar focused on AI discovery workshops and AI adoption in regulated environments. Presentation content, delivery flow, workshop methodology, and demonstration material were reviewed. Feedback centred on simplifying slides, increasing the use of people-focused visuals, strengthening messaging around responsible AI adoption, and ensuring the session remains educational rather than sales-led. The team agreed to continue practising delivery and refine the webinar content ahead of the live session.

A potential engagement approach for GlaxoSmithKline was discussed, focused on process evaluation, AI discovery workshops and training.
